method.ab: the same envelope is projected twice with the real projector: format_aci_result(compact=False) is the pre-change rendering, format_aci_result(compact=True) is current
method.attribution: content and line_wrapper are computed exactly (a JSON array of N strings costs the text plus 4N); digest, path and counts are measured by deleting those fields and re-projecting, which only removes content so no part can go negative; `residual` is the key names, braces, commas and array containers no single value owns
method.reproducible_call: a call counts only when one of the two projections reproduces the token count the stored live run recorded, so a client change without a live re-run fails instead of comparing across projections
